title: Adding Licenses to a Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) Subscription
content:
**Clause 1. When licenses may be added.** Licenses may be added to a Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) subscription at any time during its term. Added licenses share the subscription's term end date and its locked unit price.

**Clause 2. Status gate.** License additions may be posted only while the subscription status is provisioning or active, as the subscription record shows. A suspended, expired or cancelled subscription takes no additions.

**Clause 3. Former charging clause, no longer in force for every subscription.** This clause is no longer in force as a rule for every subscription: "A seat addition is charged for the rest of the billing cycle in which it is submitted: the unit price times the licenses added times the number of calendar days from the date of submission through the cycle's last day inclusive, divided by the number of days in that cycle, rounded half up to the cent; later cycles include the added licenses in the cycle charge."

- On a subscription whose billing cycle runs its whole term (a P1M term, or a P1Y term billed annually), the charge for the rest of the cycle in which a seat addition is submitted is set under the partial-cycle charge schedule for such subscriptions. Later cycles include the added licenses in the cycle charge.
- On any other subscription, a seat addition is still charged for the rest of the billing cycle in which it is submitted. The charge is the unit price times the licenses added times the calendar days from the date of submission through the cycle's last day inclusive, divided by the days in that cycle, rounded half up to the cent. Later cycles include the added licenses in the cycle charge.

**Clause 4. Quantities not prorated.** The initial purchase quantity is billed by the first cycle charge, not by proration. A renewal increase takes effect on the renewal date and is billed by the renewal term's cycle charges.

## Which charge applies (by kind of license addition)

| Kind of addition | How it is billed |
|---|---|
| Initial purchase quantity | First cycle charge |
| Seat addition, subscription on P1M or on P1Y billed annually | Partial-cycle charge schedule for such subscriptions |
| Seat addition, any other subscription (for example P1Y or P3Y billed monthly) | Unit price times licenses times remaining days of the cycle, divided by the cycle's days |
| Renewal increase | The renewal term's cycle charges, from the renewal date |

**Hypothetical illustration of clause 3, second bullet.** A P3Y subscription billed monthly has a unit price of 20.00 USD. Its cycle runs from 1 April to 30 April, which is 30 days. 3 licenses are added on 21 April, leaving 10 days through 30 April. The charge is 20.00 times 3 times 10, divided by 30, which is 20.00.

superseded_clauses: A seat addition is charged for the rest of the billing cycle in which it is submitted: unit_price_usd times qty times the number of calendar days from the date part of effective_at through the cycle's last day inclusive, divided by the number of days in that cycle, rounded half up to the cent; later cycles include the added licenses in the cycle charge.
